primary_question: At n=10, does Stage2 improve actual pack V over both Current-only and capacity-feature prediction?

methods.current_only: one baseline at all n_i=10; column 1 descending; cost 860; no extra diagnosis
methods.capacity_features_v3: V2 ten capacity features adapted explicitly to two RPT inputs
methods.stage2_screened20: same estimator search and packing as capacity_features_v3; only input features differ
methods.capacity_updated: auxiliary same-budget control; use latest revealed capacity at each uniform budget

rul_target: T_eol - (n_i + 1); deployment starts at C_full column n_i/5, cycle n_i+1
rul_point: exp(predicted log RUL), median; common definition for both learned methods
assembly_primary: descending predicted RUL, consecutive packs, bottom remainder unused
assembly_secondary: scenario-based swaps only after primary feature comparison; distinguish RUL surrogate from predicted V

folds.preprocessing: imputation, scaling, supervised feature selection fit on training only
folds.full_86_OOF_pack_value: exploratory cross-fitted inventory result; not independent held-out pack generalization
folds.heldout_fold_pack_value: supplementary 17-18-cell inventory only; different N from main 86-cell experiment

models.uncertainty_calibration: defer adaptive policy until training-only calibration design is implemented

feature_validation.identity: align by explicit cell ID, never row position alone
provenance_required_before_independent_c: each feature uses only observations revealed at n_i
screened20 selection did not use evaluation-cell targets; otherwise rerun inside outer training folds
feature_validation.schema_status: proposed adapter; actual keys and selection structure must be inspected when files arrive

oracle.approximation_rule: label feasible search value as lower bound, regrouping relaxation as upper bound; never substitute either for exact oracle silently

adaptive_followup.DFF_reference: assignment computed from policy-visible predictions, not true-future oracle
adaptive_followup.comparison: same fitted predictor, fold, scenarios, assembly and budget; vary acquisition only
adaptive_followup.objective: evaluate actual V after diagnosis; DFF is acquisition heuristic, not a reward
adaptive_followup.stop_rule: evaluate stopping only after fixed-budget curves, no automatic early-stop claim
